query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New Conversation',
  `model` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'llama3',
  `systemPrompt` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `isArchived` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  CONSTRAINT `conversations_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `messages` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `conversationId` int NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('system','user','assistant','tool') NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `model` varchar(128),
  `tokenCount` int,
  `durationMs` int,
  `tokensPerSecond` varchar(32),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `messages_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `system_prompts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `isDefault` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `system_prompts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tool_executions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `conversationId` int,
  `messageId` int,
  `toolName` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `toolInput` text NOT NULL,
  `toolOutput` text,
  `status` enum('running','success','error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
  `durationMs` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `tool_executions_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `agent_steps` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `taskId` int NOT NULL,
  `stepIndex` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `toolName` varchar(64),
  `toolInput` text,
  `toolOutput` text,
  `status` enum('pending','running','completed','failed','skipped') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `durationMs` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `agent_steps_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `agent_tasks` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `conversationId` int,
  `goal` text NOT NULL,
  `plan` text,
  `status` enum('planning','running','paused','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planning',
  `currentStep` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `totalSteps` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `result` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `agent_tasks_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_settings` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `key` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `value` text NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `app_settings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `connectors` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `config` text,
  `status` enum('active','inactive','error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive',
  `lastSyncAt` timestamp,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `connectors_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `memories` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `value` text NOT NULL,
  `source` varchar(128),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `memories_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `research_sessions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `conversationId` int,
  `query` text NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('running','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
  `sourcesCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `findings` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `research_sessions_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `scheduled_tasks` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `cronExpression` varchar(64),
  `prompt` text NOT NULL,
  `model` varchar(128),
  `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `lastRunAt` timestamp,
  `nextRunAt` timestamp,
  `lastResult` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `scheduled_tasks_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `skills` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `category` varchar(64),
  `instructions` text NOT NULL,
  `triggerCommand` varchar(64),
  `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `skills_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
